nodes.label: Four separate tasks
nodes.summary: Different populations and difficulty; never collapsed into one dengue accuracy.

nodes.label: Tuned for sensitivity
nodes.summary: Clinical models optimise sensitivity, not accuracy: missing a case costs more than a false alarm.

nodes.label: Serology is label, not feature
nodes.summary: NS1/IgM/IgG are the confirmatory tests. Feeding them in as predictors is circular.

nodes.label: DATASET_MULTIMODAL_V8
nodes.summary: 4.7M Brazilian municipality-weeks, 2010-2025, with climate, MODIS, ENSO, land cover and sanitation.

nodes.label: denguedatahub
nodes.summary: Sri Lanka district-weekly surveillance, 2006-present. Structured and reliable but lags the publisher by months.

nodes.label: Mendeley 6fsrsk3mb8
nodes.summary: 1,511 febrile patients, 19 CBC variables. The only screening dataset that passed the integrity audit.

nodes.label: NASA POWER
nodes.summary: Daily reanalysis weather at district centroids. One source for all districts to avoid a spurious source effect.

nodes.label: Three rejected datasets
nodes.summary: xrsbyjs24t, 673swz9tb4, zdtc3n6xv2. Synthetic or rule-labelled.

nodes.label: Epidemiology Unit WER
nodes.summary: Sri Lanka Weekly Epidemiological Report PDFs. Current to about six weeks.

nodes.label: Zenodo 6476112
nodes.summary: 303 paediatric dengue admissions with symptoms, fever duration and organ labs.

nodes.label: Runtime dependencies
nodes.summary: streamlit, pandas, numpy, plotly, joblib, scikit-learn, lightgbm, pyarrow. Training-only packages deliberately excluded.

nodes.label: Streamlit Community Cloud
nodes.summary: Auto-rebuilds on every push to main. Needs a one-time browser sign-in.

nodes.label: Reliability diagram
nodes.summary: Predicted versus observed outbreak frequency, raw and isotonic.

nodes.label: SHAP driver chart
nodes.summary: Share of total absolute SHAP by driver group.

nodes.label: SHAP summary plot
nodes.summary: Per-feature SHAP distribution for the 14-day forecast.

nodes.label: Attribution is not incremental value
nodes.summary: SHAP credits ~50% of the continuation model to environment, but removing it costs only +0.006 PR-AUC and environment alone (0.597) is worse than persistence (0.760).

nodes.label: Environment matters for emergence
nodes.summary: Environment adds +0.006 PR-AUC for continuation but +0.089 for emergence, a 12-15x difference consistent across three configurations. The central result.

nodes.label: Generalises to unseen places
nodes.summary: Unseen municipalities score PR-AUC 0.955 against 0.962 for seen ones. It did not merely memorise place identity.

nodes.label: Public datasets are synthetic
nodes.summary: Three of four public dengue screening datasets are synthetic. One has body temperature completely disjoint between classes; another's label is reproduced at 98.97% by platelet < 150,000. Models trained on them collapse to AUC 0.53-0.61 on real patients, worse than guessing.

nodes.label: Tracks trajectory, not emergence
nodes.summary: Recall 0.92 where incidence is already high, near zero where it is low. 54.5% of false alarms are districts already at epidemic level, 37x the true-negative rate.

nodes.label: Zero-shot transfer fails
nodes.summary: The same model scoring 0.910 on Brazil reaches 0.449 on Sri Lanka, below the persistence baseline of 0.476. Local training reaches 0.708.

nodes.label: Ablation ran on the wrong cohort
nodes.norm_label: ablation ran on the wrong cohort
nodes.summary: The symptom and fever-day ablation was run on the complication cohort, not the screening cohort. No audited dataset has both dengue-negative controls and symptoms, so the effect is inferred across tasks, not measured.

nodes.label: No prospective validation
nodes.summary: Every result is retrospective. Nothing tested against a live feed.

nodes.label: Assumes complete reporting
nodes.summary: Headline figures assume full reporting at week close; a realistic two-week delay costs 0.045 PR-AUC.

nodes.label: Sri Lanka is not calibrated
nodes.summary: ECE 0.046 and overconfident in the top band: predicts ~0.81 where outbreaks occur ~0.54 of the time. The ranking is more reliable than the number.

nodes.label: Leave-group-out ablation
nodes.summary: Historical-only vs environment-only vs combined, against persistence.

nodes.label: Dataset integrity audit
nodes.summary: Any single feature at AUC >= 0.95, or disjoint class-conditional ranges, blocks the dataset before modelling.

nodes.label: Isotonic calibration
nodes.summary: Cuts expected calibration error from 0.0190 to 0.0052 on Brazil. Sri Lanka remains uncalibrated at 0.046.

nodes.label: Temporal-leakage audit
nodes.summary: Prediction timestamp -> feature cutoff -> target window, verified per row. No lag column matched a future value.

nodes.label: Nested cross-validation
nodes.summary: Tuning inside each outer fold so the reported screening score is unbiased.

nodes.label: SHAP attribution
nodes.summary: Distributes credit among correlated features; overstates environment.

nodes.label: Shuffled-label control
nodes.summary: Performance collapses to 0.124 against a 0.144 chance rate. The decisive leakage test.

nodes.label: Spatial holdout
nodes.summary: Whole municipalities, then whole states, held out to separate memorised place identity from learned relationships.

nodes.label: Temporal holdout
nodes.summary: Train <=2021, validate 2022-23, test 2024-25. Test set locked; thresholds tuned on validation only.

nodes.label: Complication risk
nodes.summary: Among dengue patients, who needs closer monitoring? ROC-AUC 0.874, sensitivity 90.5%, NPV 0.962.

nodes.label: Outbreak continuation
nodes.summary: Will an existing outbreak persist 14 days? PR-AUC 0.961, accuracy 96.7%.

nodes.label: Outbreak emergence
nodes.summary: Will a NEW outbreak begin in a quiet district? PR-AUC 0.583, 14.3x lift. The honest early-warning task.

nodes.label: Dengue screening
nodes.summary: Does this patient appear to have dengue? ROC-AUC 0.681, accuracy 76.2% against a 0.685 majority-class baseline. Modest.

nodes.label: Trivial baseline
nodes.summary: Never predict an outbreak: 86.5% accuracy. Why accuracy is not the headline.

nodes.label: PR-AUC and recall lead
nodes.summary: 86.5% of municipality-weeks are negative, so accuracy flatters everything. Always quote the trivial baseline alongside.
